title: Ledger
intro: Track records based on what public actors actually said and did, measured with the same rubric for everyone. No single good-or-bad score.
conductNote: We describe conduct, never character. Crimes are only mentioned after a final court ruling.
factual: {bad} of {n} analyzed claims were contradicted or mostly unsupported by evidence.
notEnough: Not enough analyzed claims yet (n = {n}; a score needs at least 10).
noReply: No reply yet. Verified contacts can respond, and replies are published alongside the record.
respond: Are you {name} or their representative? Respond
empty: No profiles are published yet. Profiles appear only after legal review of the rubric and each profile.
